review_candidates.title: Marketing Business Development Executive
review_candidates.description: Business Development & Marketing Executive Catalyst ExecEd | Egypt About Catalyst ExecEd Catalyst ExecEd is an executive education and professional development platform focused on helping professionals and organizations move From Insight to Impact. We deliver executive education programs, professional certifications, customized corporate training, and practical workshops across areas including Operational Excellence, Leadership & Management, Digital & AI, and other business-critical capabilities. We are looking for a Business Development & Marketing Executive to join us at an exciting growth stage and play a hands-on role in expanding Catalyst beyond our current Operational Excellence portfolio. The Role This is a hands-on, growth-oriented role combining marketing, business development, partnerships, program development, and customer experience. You will work closely with the Catalyst founder/instructors to grow our market presence, generate new business opportunities, identify new programs and instructors, and build relationships with companies, professionals, universities, training organizations, and potential partners. This is ideal for someone who enjoys talking to people, creating opportunities, attending events, following up with leads, understanding customer needs, and turning ideas into business. Key Responsibilities Marketing & Social Media Manage and grow Catalyst ExecEd’s social media presence, particularly LinkedIn and Facebook. Develop and execute content calendars and campaigns. Coordinate with instructors to turn their expertise into engaging content and promotional campaigns. Manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns and coordinate with external agencies/freelancers when needed. Monitor campaign performance, leads, engagement, and conversion. Continuously test new ideas to improve reach, lead generation, and program registrations. Business Development & Corporate Sales Identify and approach potential corporate clients for customized training and executive education. Build and maintain a pipeline of corporate opportunities. Conduct outreach through LinkedIn, email, phone calls, networking, and events. Arrange meetings with HR, L&D, Talent, Operations, and business leaders. Follow up with prospects and support proposals, quotations, and commercial discussions. Develop relationships with companies, universities, professional organizations, and training partners. Identify partnership and collaboration opportunities that can expand Catalyst’s reach. Portfolio & Program Development Research market needs and identify new training and executive education opportunities beyond Operational Excellence. Identify potential instructors, subject-matter experts, and training partners. Connect with qualified instructors and explore potential collaboration opportunities. Support the development and launch of new programs based on market demand. Track competitor offerings, market trends, and emerging professional skills. Help build a diversified Catalyst portfolio across Leadership, Management, Digital & AI, Business, Supply Chain, and other relevant areas. E vents, Conferences & Customer Experience Represent Catalyst at conferences, exhibitions, networking events, and business meetings. Identify potential leads and partnership opportunities at events. Attend selected training sessions and workshops as a participant/observer to understand the learner experience and identify opportunities for improvement. Gather participant feedback and translate it into actionable improvements. Support the end-to-end learner journey, from first inquiry through registration, participation, and post-program engagement. Help develop the Catalyst alumni and professional community. Growth & Commercial Performance Maintain accurate lead and opportunity tracking. Monitor KPIs including leads, conversion rates, campaign performance, corporate opportunities, partnerships, and revenue contribution. Prepare regular business development and marketing reports. Proactively suggest new channels, campaigns, partnerships, and commercial opportunities. What We’re Looking For 2–5 years of experience in business development, sales, marketing, training, education, or a related field. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Comfortable reaching out to new people and building professional relationships. Good understanding of social media marketing, particularly LinkedIn. Hands-on experience with Meta Ads and/or LinkedIn Ads is a strong advantage. Strong research and market-development skills. Excellent follow-up and organization skills. Ability to identify opportunities and take initiative without waiting for instructions. Strong English communication skills, written and spoken. Good presentation and negotiation skills. Comfortable attending conferences, meetings, and networking events. Proficiency in Microsoft Office / Google Workspace; familiarity with CRM and marketing tools is a plus. The Person We’re Looking For More than a specific degree or job title, we’re looking for someone who is: Curious — always looking for new markets, programs, instructors, and opportunities. Commercially minded — understands that activity should ultimately create business value. Proactive — doesn’t wait for leads or opportunities to come to them. People-oriented — enjoys networking, conversations, meetings, and building relationships. Hands-on — willing to write a post, launch a campaign, call a prospect, attend an event, research an instructor, and follow up with a client. Entrepreneurial — comfortable working in a growing education business where responsibilities evolve quickly. Why Join Catalyst? Work directly with the leadership team in a growing executive education business. Have a real impact on the company’s growth and market direction. Exposure to executive education, corporate training, marketing, sales, and business development. Opportunity to build relationships with senior professionals, companies, instructors, and industry leaders. A dynamic role with significant room for ownership and development. Location : Alexandria, Egypt Employment Type : Full-time (Hybrid) Interested? If you are a marketer, business developer, relationship builder, or ambitious commercial professional who enjoys creating opportunities and building something from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you. Apply with your CV and a short note explaining why you believe you can help Catalyst ExecEd grow.
